concerns.text: Task T007 aligns salience scores, ROI masks, fixation metrics, low‑level visual features, and semantic covariates into a single analysis dataset. It requires moral‑valence and scene‑complexity covariates, which are only produced later by Task T009. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation; T009 must run before T007 (or T007 must be split to run after T009).

Task T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but performs project‑layout creation and writes `requirements.txt` and `quickstart.md`. These files are foundational and must be created before any downstream task that reads them; marking it as parallel‑safe is unsafe and violates the foundational‑tasks‑first principle.
